changelog: New BigPicture Mode: A cinematic full-screen PC interface designed for large displays and couch gaming.
Gamepad Support: Full controller integration for Xbox, PlayStation, and generic pads with dynamic alerts.
Image & Speed Upgrades: Optimized image blur rendering across standard components and smoother carousels.

features.title: What's New
items: Full BigPicture Experience: A fresh cinematic full-screen interface featuring an animated startup screen, auto-playing trailer backdrops, and dedicated detail pages.
Gamepad Integration: Instant detection for Xbox, PlayStation, and generic controllers with visual status notifications, sound effects, and an on-screen virtual cursor.
BigPicture Navigation & Tools: Directional pad navigation, virtual keyboard search, episode jumping, server selection, and background route preloading for seamless screen switching.

features.title: Interface & Usability
items: Upgraded What's New Page: Redesigned release notes layout for clearer feature discovery, structured change categories, and smoother loading states.
Instant Sound Feedback: Real-time audio response for menu navigation, button presses, and notifications without delay.
Smarter Menu Controls: Smooth back button handling for menus, search overlays, and video detail popups.
Refined Layouts: Modernized top navigation bar for desktop and mobile, improved bottom bar controls, and clearer network status alerts.

features.title: Standard Mode Upgrades
items: Enhanced Image Loading Performance: Rebuilt preview blur engine integrated across almost all standard components for faster rendering and reduced layout shifts.
Smoother Content Lists: Rebuilt carousels, media grids, and news feeds with clearer loading placeholders and status indicators.
